wizard.gap.title: EVIDENCE GAP DETECTED: BOTANICAL TAXON OR PART MISSING
wizard.gap.desc: Biological Diversity Act (ABS) and Section 3(p) analysis require exact binomial nomenclature and plant part.
wizard.validation.titleRequired: Please enter a descriptive case title for your formulation or project.
wizard.selectTreatises: Select all authoritative treatises that ground the ingredients, preparation, or traditional use:
wizard.classicalCitation: This formulation is directly cited in an authoritative classical treatise (First Schedule)
wizard.indicationsPlaceholder: Detail primary clinical indications, traditional therapeutic effects (Karma/Dosha prabhava), or dietary wellness benefits...
wizard.prepNarrativePlaceholder: Describe step-by-step extraction solvents, ratios, temperature, particle size, and any purification steps...
wizard.docAddPlaceholder: Add document (e.g. HPLC finger-printing, Safety report, Batch record)...
wizard.cat.ayurvedicDesc: Polyherbal or herbo-mineral preparations based on traditional or proprietary formulations.
wizard.cat.herbalDesc: Standardized botanical extracts, phytopharmaceuticals, or dietary supplements.
wizard.cat.traditionalDesc: Documented classical practices, tribal remedies, or community health traditions.
wizard.cat.plantDesc: Raw botanical species, cultivated varieties, or wild-harvested medicinal flora.
wizard.cat.processDesc: Novel extraction techniques, shelf-life stabilization, or bio-enhancement processes.
wizard.cat.brandDesc: Names, distinctive packaging, or Geographical Indication (GI) association.
wizard.prep.classicalDesc: Swarasa, Kwatha, Taila Paka, Bhasma Shodhana described in 54 First Schedule texts.
wizard.prep.extractDesc: Hydro-alcoholic, aqueous, or supercritical CO2 extraction with quantified biomarker assays.
wizard.prep.novelDesc: Nanotechnology carrier, phytosome, liposomal entrapment, or modified fermentation.
wizard.commercial.domesticDesc: Retail manufacturing, direct-to-consumer Ayurvedic medicines, or OTC Ayurveda-Aahar.
wizard.commercial.exportDesc: Complying with FDA Dietary Supplement cGMP (21 CFR Part 111) or EU Traditional Herbal Medicinal Products Directive (THMPD).
wizard.commercial.rdDesc: Pre-clinical validation, pilot trials, or grant-funded scientific documentation.
wizard.commercial.licensingDesc: Seeking patent or trade secret protection prior to commercial licensing.
wizard.jur.indiaDesc: Drugs & Cosmetics Act 1940, Rule 158B, Schedule T GMP, BDA 2002 ABS.
wizard.jur.usDesc: DSHEA 1994, 21 CFR Part 111 Dietary Supplements, NDI notifications.
wizard.jur.intlDesc: Patent Cooperation Treaty filing + regional nutraceutical filings.
